extraction.Name: Elizabeth Stirk, nee Cottier
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her allotment, on account of paying taxes, that she refused it, but that she got two different letters, advising her to accept it, which she did
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged her 160 acres, to the State Bank of Scenic, Scenic, South Dakota, to get money to pay taxes on it, as well as on the allotment of her husband, George Stirk, and other debts
extraction.Buyer: State Bank of Scenic, Scenic, South Dakota (foreclosed mortgage about 1926)
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: mortgaged to get money to pay taxes on it, as well as on the allotment of her husband, George Stirk, and other debts; mortgage was foreclosed about 1926
extraction.NOTES: Husband is George Stirk; husband's allotment is an improved place, hers is just raw land; she wanted to save the husband's allotment in preference to hers; mentally competent and in good health; health of the entire family is good; has never received any aid from the County or United States Government; document sworn before a notary public in County of Shannon, 1928
